per_task_fields.source_files_hashes: submitted artifacts bound to final receipt
per_task_fields.machine_check: passed after complete final/submission gates, failed, or unattempted; controller only
per_task_fields.semantic_check: optional passed/failed/pending annotation; never gates machine success or the primary score
per_task_fields.assumption_check: mandatory automatic trust/axiom gate; optional broader mathematical review is separate
per_task_fields.final_score: 1 for machine-passed tasks, 0 for finished machine failures, null for unattempted tasks; semantic annotations do not affect it
per_task_fields.terminal_reason: completed, verification_failed, timeout, dependency_blocked, environment_error or not_attempted; optional semantic mismatch is an annotation, not an automatic terminal failure
per_task_fields.task_elapsed_seconds: monotonic elapsed including setup in task, tool calls, retries, restart and final check
per_task_fields.checker_seconds: separate diagnostic; do not sum overlapping durations into wall time
per_task_fields.request_attempt_ids: one ID for each actual model request including retries and compaction
per_task_fields.usage_summary: normalized totals, known subtotal and missing-request coverage per field
per_task_fields.task_attempt_count: Cumulative task attempts including earlier all-API windows; never reset historical counts.
per_task_fields.task_retry_count: max(0, task_attempt_count - 1); helpers do not get additional allowances.
per_task_fields.attempt_window_used: Attempts used in current window, at most five; includes network/API failures.
per_task_fields.network_wait_seconds: Actual active time waiting for a connection retry; included in task elapsed, also exposed separately.

usage_collection.primary: final raw API usage per unique request attempt when available
usage_collection.fallback: final Pi usage with established observation provenance
never_sum: raw and Pi views of the same request
reasoning again on top of output
cached input again on top of raw prompt_tokens
include: tool results included in subsequent prompts
usage_collection.missing_usage: null plus known subtotal and coverage; never silently zero
usage_collection.tool_nested_models: disallowed in the initial solver treatment
usage_collection.context_compaction_policy: same trigger and model on both sides; record events and usage
usage_collection.cache_policy: record hits and randomize pair order; do not claim remote cold-cache control

run_summary.correct_rate: primary operational accuracy: machine-passed propositions / preregistered scope N (48 for Book I, 465 for full run)
run_summary.pending_audits: optional annotations only; never suppress the primary score or prevent publication
run_summary.total_build_seconds: sum actual active serial task work plus required integration; preparation and human audit listed separately
run_summary.total_build_tokens: all model work in run, including foundation and helper tasks, failures and recovery
run_summary.tokens_per_correct: total_build_tokens / machine_passed_proposition_count when usage is complete and the count is positive; otherwise null
run_summary.joint_success_comparison: paired time/token ratios on mutually machine-passed propositions, with subset size disclosed
run_summary.coverage_curves: correct coverage vs cumulative active wall seconds, and vs cumulative reported tokens if accounting complete
run_summary.repeat_unit: independent library-building run, not individual dependent theorem
run_summary.semantic_accuracy: optional separate source-fidelity score, unavailable without semantic reviews; not the primary accuracy

success_policy.accuracy_definition: machine-verified propositions divided by registered propositions

limits.round_definition: Five total attempts per task window: complete code candidate, generation failure or network/API failure. Final verification/publication excluded after whole candidate acceptance. All-API exhausted windows checkpoint the same task for explicit restart with full history retained.
